name: Dynamic Aquatic Barriers, Floods, Dams & Connectivity Changes
design_rules: connectivity changes are event-driven and time-limited unless the world state persists them
floods may open temporary channels while droughts may isolate shallow routes
dam breaks can sharply increase connectivity for a limited period
landslides may create new barriers without deleting the underlying watershed topology
species still respect their barrier tolerance after event modifiers are applied
dynamic connectivity never creates or destroys population directly
barrier state can be serialized independently of visual rendering
aquatic connectivity changes never use emissive or glow feedback
